name: Iasmin Lucindo
summary: A strong, athletic young Brazilian strawweight (18-6, 5-2 UFC) who wins with clinch strength, heavy hooks and takedowns into top control, usually over three rounds. She returns from a nine-month CSAD suspension (mesterolone, attributed to a contaminated supplement) and has not fought since beating Angela Hill in August 2025.

how_they_fight.Striking: Not a volume striker (about 2.9 significant strikes a minute) but she hits harder than most strawweights: against Hill and Kowalkiewicz her hooks were the heavier shots. Uses feints and twitches early. Early-career she finished a lot on the feet (8 KO/TKO wins on the regionals), but her last KO win in our data is from 2021.
how_they_fight.Grappling: The base of her UFC game: clinches, drags opponents off the fence and works from top, often half guard and side control. 3 of 7 takedowns vs Hill, 4 of 5 vs Brogan Walker, nearly six minutes of control vs Kowalkiewicz. Has an arm-triangle finish (Polyana Viana, round two) but more often rides out rounds; referees have told her to stay busy.
how_they_fight.Defense: Solid striking defense and hard to hold down, though Amanda Lemos took her down and controlled her for almost eight minutes. Has not been stopped since 2019; her three stoppage losses all came on the Brazilian regionals.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Steady, not explosive; she grows into fights and has won late rounds with takedowns (Hill, Rodriguez). In our data her 11 finishes came three in round one, six in round two and two in round three, but her last four fights all went the distance. Her losses are mostly on points (two decisions, one split). Responded well to adversity vs Hill: dropped early in round three per Cageside (our data credits Hill with no knockdown), she got straight up and took Hill down.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Good at picking the phase she wins, but can go passive: against Lemos she landed zero significant strikes in the first two rounds per LowKick and was booed. A late takedown against Marina Rodriguez was taken away for a chin into the eye, per Cageside.

patterns: Clinch early, drag down along the fence
Harder single hooks than opponents in exchanges
Wins rounds on control rather than damage
Four of her five UFC wins went to decision
concerns: Ring rust: about 14 months out by fight night
First fight after a doping suspension
Can go flat and passive when out-wrestled (Lemos)
Low output gives judges close rounds (split decisions vs Rodriguez and Sarah Frota)
keys_to_beat: Out-wrestle her or stay off the fence; Lemos beat her with takedowns and top control
Win on volume: she throws less than most strawweights
Make her work off her back where she has been passive
Kicks at range before she can close to the clinch

news.text: Booked against Nicolle Caliari at strawweight for UFC 333 (RotoWire, citing Nolan King of USA Today).

CSAD suspended her nine months for mesterolone from an out-of-competition sample taken 24 September 2025; reduced from a year because of a possible contaminated compounded supplement. Eligible 24 June 2026 per Cageside (RotoWire said late July).
Pulled out of a December bout with Gillian Robertson at UFC Vegas 112 after the adverse finding.
